            "clips": clip_names(client, project), "unsaved": whole.get("unsaved_changes")}


def sheet_rows(client, files, facts):
    """S1 and S2, on GF in the instance: the dev tools; nothing is confirmed."""
    print("\n2 — the three items over MCP: S1, S2", flush=True)
    project = str(files)
    paths = [["File", act[0]] for act in ACTS]

    def rows_of(items):
        return [next((i for i in items if i.get("path") == path), {}) for path in paths]

    def cancel():
        return gp.attempt(client, "cancel_sheet", {"project": project})

    # S1 — listed, classified, and Rename greyed while a nest is open
    items = menu_items(client, files)
    listed = [i.get("path") for i in items]
    image = ["File", "Add Image to Graphics…"]
    at = listed.index(image) if image in listed else -10
    after_image = listed[at + 1:at + 4] if at >= 0 else []
    outside = rows_of(items)
    opened = gp.attempt(client, "set_scope", {"project": project, "nest": facts["nest"]})
    inside = rows_of(menu_items(client, files))
    refused = gp.attempt(client, "perform_menu_item", {"project": project, "path": paths[0]})
    stray = None
    if refused["ok"]:        # a sheet a mutant put up: taken down before the next row
        stray = cancel()
    closed = gp.attempt(client, "set_scope", {"project": project})
    back = rows_of(menu_items(client, files))
    check("S1 perform_menu_item lists the three items straight after Add Image to Graphics…, "
          "each a sheet with no refusal and enabled; with the nest open Rename is disabled, "
          "the other two enabled, and performing it is refused as disabled here; back out it "
          "is enabled",
          after_image == paths
          and all(r.get("verdict") == "sheet" and r.get("refusal") is None
                  and r.get("enabled") is True for r in outside)
          and opened["ok"] and [r.get("enabled") for r in inside] == [False, True, True]
          and (not refused["ok"]) and "is disabled here" in refused["error"]
          and closed["ok"] and [r.get("enabled") for r in back] == [True, True, True],
          f"after Add Image {after_image}; outside "
          f"{[(r.get('verdict'), r.get('refusal'), r.get('enabled')) for r in outside]}; nest "
          f"{facts['nest']} open {opened.get('error', 'ok')}: "
          f"{[r.get('enabled') for r in inside]}, Rename performed: "
          f"{refused.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}"
          + (f" (stray sheet cancelled: {stray.get('error', 'ok')})" if stray else "")
          + f"; back out {[r.get('enabled') for r in back]}")

    # S2 — each sheet goes up, reads whole, lays out clean and is cancelled
    before = graphics_state(client, files)
    cleared = gp.attempt(client, "set_selection", {"project": project, "clips": []})
    good, notes = cleared["ok"], [f"set_selection {cleared.get('error', 'ok')}"]
    for index, (menu_title, title, hint, confirm, first, extra) in enumerate(ACTS):
        ran = gp.attempt(client, "perform_menu_item", {"project": project, "path": paths[index]})
        up = reply(ran).get("sheet") is not None
        picture = WORK / f"S2-{index}.png"
        shot = gp.attempt(client, "snapshot_ui",
                          {"project": project, "window": "sheet", "path": str(picture)})
        problems = reply(shot).get("problems")
        visible = []
        try:
            with open(reply(shot).get("layout_path") or "") as handle:
                visible = [v.get("text") for v in json.load(handle)["views"]
                           if not v.get("hidden") and v.get("text")]
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
            pass
        wanted = [title, hint[:200], "Cancel", confirm, first] + extra
        missing = [w for w in wanted if w not in visible]
        cancelled = cancel()
        down = (reply(cancelled).get("how") == "cancel_button"
                and "sheet" in reply(cancelled) and reply(cancelled)["sheet"] is None)
        fine = ran["ok"] and up and shot["ok"] and problems == [] and not missing and down
        good = good and fine
        notes.append(
            f"{menu_title}: performed {ran.get('error', 'ok')}, sheet {up}, snapshot "
            f"{shot.get('error', 'ok')}, problems {problems}, missing texts {missing}, cancel "
            f"{cancelled.get('error') or reply(cancelled).get('how')} → sheet "
            f"{reply(cancelled).get('sheet')}")
    after = graphics_state(client, files)
    check("S2 with nothing selected each of the three items puts its sheet up; its layout "
          "dump has no problems and shows the title, the hint, Cancel, its button and the "
          "pop-up's first graphic (other, other, gone (deleted); Restore also 1 version kept); "
          "cancel_sheet presses Cancel and no sheet is left; modules, history, every clip's "
          "graphic and unsaved_changes (false) are as before",
          good and after == before and before["unsaved"] is False
          and before["modules"] is not None,
          "; ".join(notes) + f"; state unchanged {after == before}, unsaved {after['unsaved']}")


def session(app, rows):
    """One instance in the scratch home: S0, the fixtures, then `rows(client,
    gm, gf, facts)`, the closes and Z1. False when the instance, the home or
    the fixtures failed (nothing after them ran)."""
    launched = launch(app)
    made = False
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            check("the instance listens on its scratch socket", False,
                  f"no listening line for {launched.socket_path} in {LOG}")
            return False
        support = HOME / "Library/Application Support"
        check("S0 the scratch home took: <home>/Library/Application Support is a directory",
              support.is_dir(), str(support))
        if not support.is_dir():
            return False
        gm, gf, facts, why = fixture(launched.client)
        made = gm is not None
        check("the fixture is made over MCP (GM: new_project, save_project; GF: title twice, "
              "other, spare, gone deleted, two title clips, one nested, saved)", made, why or "")
        if made:
            try:
                rows(launched.client, gm, gf, facts)
            except Exception as error:  # a row that could not run is a failure
                check("every row runs", False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            closes = [gp.attempt(launched.client, "close_project",
                                 {"project": str(package), "discard": True})
                      for package in (gm, gf)]
        else:
            closes = []
    finally:
        stop(launched)
    lines = gp.complaints(LOG)
    check("Z1 both projects close and grep \"Frame Job: \" over the log prints nothing",
          made and all(c["ok"] for c in closes) and not lines,
          f"closes {[c.get('error', 'ok') for c in closes]}; " + "; ".join(lines[:4]))
    return made


def mutate(sources, name, table):
    """Replaces the mutant's anchor, asserted once, under `sources`."""
    file, anchor, replacement, _ = table[name]
    text = (sources / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(anchor)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"anchor in {file}: expected once, found {count}")
    (sources / file).write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")
    return file


def probe_mutant(app, name):
    """Rule R for `notice-dropped`, Rule R1 for the rest: 0 caught, 1
    survived (or an earlier row failed first), 2 the control was not
    performed."""
    row = PROBE_MUTANTS[name][3]
    answered = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"framejob-graphics-menu-{name}-") as temp:
        sources = Path(temp) / "Sources"
        try:
            shutil.copytree(ROOT / "app/Sources", sources)
            file = mutate(sources, name, PROBE_MUTANTS)
        except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
            return 2
        print(f"MUTANT {name}: {file}, anchor replaced once, in {sources}")
        if not app.exists():
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — no app at {app}")
            return 2

        def rows(_client, gm, gf, _facts):
            answered.extend(probe_checks(gm, gf, sources, Path(temp) / "probe"))

        if not session(app, rows):
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — the fixture was not "
                  "made")
            return 2
    ids = [r for r, _ in answered]
    if row not in ids:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — no {row} answered")
        return 2
    failed = [r for r, ok in answered if not ok]
    caught = row in failed
    if name == "notice-dropped":     # Rule R
        if caught:
            print(f"MUTANT PASS: {name} — {row} FAILED in the copy (failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
            return 0
        print(f"MUTANT FAILURE: {name} — {row} passed")
        return 1
    earlier = [r for r, ok in answered[:ids.index(row)] if not ok]
    if caught and not earlier:
        print(f"MUTANT PASS: {name} — {row} FAILED in the copy and is the first failure "
              f"(failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
        return 0
    if earlier:
        print(f"MUTANT FAILURE: {name} — {', '.join(earlier)} failed before {row} "
              f"({row} {'FAILED' if caught else 'passed'})")
    else:
        print(f"MUTANT FAILURE: {name} — {row} passed")
    return 1


def build_app_mutant(name):
    """A copy of the tree with the mutant's anchor replaced, built by
    `tree_copy.build_app`. The binary, or None and why."""
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(WORK / "mutant"))
    if made is None:
        return None, reason
    copy = Path(made)
    try:
        mutate(copy / "app/Sources", name, APP_MUTANTS)
    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        return None, str(error)
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(copy, 1500)
    if app is None:
        return None, reason
    return proof_app.executable(app), ""


def app_mutant(name):
    """Rule R: 0 the row FAILED in the copy, 1 it passed, 2 the control was
    not performed."""
    row = APP_MUTANTS[name][3]
    print(f"graphics menu — the {name} MUTANT ({row} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    binary, why = build_app_mutant(name)
    if binary is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {why}")
        return 2
    session(binary, lambda client, _gm, gf, facts: sheet_rows(client, gf, facts))
    scored = {n.split()[0]: ok for n, ok in RESULTS}
    if row not in scored:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {row} was not reached")
        return 2
    failed = [n.split()[0] for n, ok in RESULTS if not ok]
    caught = scored[row] is False
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — {row} "
          f"{'FAILED' if caught else 'passed'} in the copy (failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--app", default=str(APP))
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(PROBE_MUTANTS) + sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    app = Path(args.app)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    remove_leftovers()
    atexit.register(remove_leftovers)
    if args.mutant in PROBE_MUTANTS:
        return probe_mutant(app, args.mutant)
    if args.mutant in APP_MUTANTS:
        return app_mutant(args.mutant)
    print("Road map 10, G5b and B84 phase 2 — the graphics menus, templates and file sheet",
          flush=True)
    if not app.exists():
        check("the app is built", False, str(app))
        print(f"\n0/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
        return 1
    print("\n0 — the bundle, the instance and the fixtures over MCP", flush=True)
    bundle_check(app)

    def rows(client, gm, gf, facts):
        probe_checks(gm, gf)
        sheet_rows(client, gf, facts)

    session(app, rows)
    good = sum(1 for _, ok in RESULTS if ok)
    print(f"\n{good}/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
    return 0 if RESULTS and good == len(RESULTS) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

368	    while Date().timeIntervalSince(start) < limit {

371	    }
372	    return condition()

542	    action()

1	// app/Sources/GraphicFileSheetController.swift — File ▸ Rename Graphic…,
2	// Delete Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version… (spec §11 G-30; issue #103,
3	// issue batch B84): ONE small sheet for the three, a pop-up of the
4	// project's graphics over the three bodies in
5	// `ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift` — the bodies `rename_graphic`,
6	// `delete_graphic` and `restore_graphic` call, so both doors refuse in the
7	// same sentences.
8	//
9	// **No second implementation.** Every act is one call of a body
10	// (`perform`); nothing here reaches a `GraphicStore` writer, an op or an
11	// undo registration, and no sentence a body throws is rewritten, prefixed
12	// or predicted: a refusal is shown word for word in `messageLabel` and the
13	// sheet stays up. The two guards written here name the CALL (spec §11
14	// D2-1): a new name that is empty or unchanged (`canConfirm`), and an item
15	// with nothing to list (`isOffered`).
16	//
17	// **`perform` runs from the button's action only**: each body ends in
18	// `rescan()`, which must never run from a `.graphicsDidChange` observer.
19	// Rename's `apply` is `performGroupedEdit`, never `applyEdit`: the clips'
20	// new name is one CLOSED undo step wherever the action was sent from, it
21	// does not throw, and the body's own re-read moves the file back when the
22	// edit was refused.
23	
24	import AppKit
25	
26	/// One of the three file acts a person can ask for.
27	enum GraphicFileAct: CaseIterable {
28	    case rename, delete, restore
29	
30	    /// The File menu's title.
31	    var menuTitle: String {
32	        switch self {
33	        case .rename: return "Rename Graphic…"
34	        case .delete: return "Delete Graphic…"
35	        case .restore: return "Restore Graphic Version…"
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    /// The sheet's title: the menu's without its "…".
40	    var sheetTitle: String { String(menuTitle.dropLast()) }
41	
42	    var confirmTitle: String {
43	        switch self {
44	        case .rename: return "Rename"
45	        case .delete: return "Delete"
46	        case .restore: return "Restore"
47	        }
48	    }
49	
50	    /// The sentence under the title (spec §11 G-30 (c), word for word).
51	    var hint: String {
52	        switch self {
53	        case .rename:
54	            return "Every clip that uses the graphic follows its new name, on the timeline and "
55	                + "inside nests. Undo renames it back when a clip uses it; a graphic no clip "
56	                + "uses is renamed back by renaming it again."
57	        case .delete:
58	            return "A graphic that clips still use cannot be deleted. Its code is kept with its "
59	                + "earlier versions, so Restore Graphic Version… brings it back. Deleting is "
60	                + "not an Undo step."
61	        case .restore:
62	            return "Puts back the newest kept version of the graphic's code. If the graphic has "
63	                + "code now, that code is kept in its place, so restoring again returns to "
64	                + "where you were. Restoring is not an Undo step."
65	        }
66	    }
67	}
68	
69	/// One row of the sheet's pop-up.
70	struct GraphicFileChoice: Equatable {
71	    let name: String
72	    /// No `graphics/<name>.js`: a deleted module that still has kept texts.
73	    let deleted: Bool
74	    /// How many texts of it are kept.
75	    let kept: Int
76	
77	    var title: String { deleted ? "\(name) (deleted)" : name }
78	}
79	
80	final class GraphicFileSheetController: NSViewController, NSTextFieldDelegate {
81	    /// Weak, like every sheet's back-reference.
82	    private weak var document: ProjectDocument?
83	    private let act: GraphicFileAct
84	    private let choices: [GraphicFileChoice]
85	    private let opening: String?
86	
87	    private let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
88	    private let nameField = NSTextField(string: "")
89	    private let keptLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
90	    private let messageLabel = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
91	    private let confirmButton: NSButton
92	
93	    private static let controlWidth: CGFloat = 240
94	
95	    // MARK: - The model
96	
97	    /// The rows an act lists, by name: the folder's modules for Rename and
98	    /// Delete; every name with a kept text for Restore, deleted modules
99	    /// included. Empty with no store.
100	    static func choices(for act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument)
101	        -> [GraphicFileChoice]
102	    {
103	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return [] }
104	        let names: [String]
105	        switch act {
106	        case .rename, .delete:
107	            return store.scan.modules.keys.sorted().map {
108	                GraphicFileChoice(name: $0, deleted: false, kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
109	            }
110	        case .restore:
111	            names = store.keptNames()
112	        }
113	        return names.map {
114	            GraphicFileChoice(
115	                name: $0, deleted: !store.holdsModule(named: $0),
116	                kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
117	        }
118	    }
119	
120	    /// Whether the menu item is live: something to list, and for Rename no
121	    /// nest open (spec §11 G-28 (g)). A validator asks this on every menu
122	    /// open, so it answers whether `choices` would be empty without
123	    /// building them: Rename and Delete from the last scan, Restore from
124	    /// `keptNames()`, and no row's `kept` count is read.
125	    static func isOffered(_ act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument) -> Bool {
126	        if act == .rename, document.scope != nil { return false }
127	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return false }
128	        switch act {
129	        case .rename, .delete: return !store.scan.modules.isEmpty
130	        case .restore: return !store.keptNames().isEmpty
131	        }
132	    }
133	
134	    /// The row the sheet opens on: for Rename and Restore the selected
135	    /// clip's graphic when it is a row, else — and always for Delete, whose
136	    /// selected clip's graphic is in use — the first; nil with no rows.
137	    static func opening(
138	        for act: GraphicFileAct, selected: String?, in choices: [GraphicFileChoice]
139	    ) -> String? {
140	        var asked = selected
141	        if act == .delete { asked = nil }
142	        if let asked = asked, choices.contains(where: { $0.name == asked }) { return asked }
143	        return choices.first?.name
144	    }
145	
146	    static func keptLine(_ kept: Int) -> String {
147	        kept == 1 ? "1 version kept" : "\(kept) versions kept"
148	    }
149	
150	    /// Whether the button is live: Rename needs a new name that is not the
151	    /// chosen one.
152	    static func canConfirm(_ act: GraphicFileAct, name: String, to: String) -> Bool {
153	        act != .rename || (!to.isEmpty && to != name)
154	    }
155	
156	    /// The act itself: one call of the body its tool calls. `to` is
157	    /// Rename's alone and goes to the body as typed.
158	    static func perform(
159	        _ act: GraphicFileAct, name: String, to: String, on document: ProjectDocument
160	    ) throws {
161	        switch act {
162	        case .rename:
163	            _ = try document.renameGraphic(named: name, to: to) {
164	                document.performGroupedEdit("Rename Graphic", $0)
165	            }
166	        case .delete:
167	            _ = try document.deleteGraphic(named: name)
168	        case .restore:
169	            _ = try document.restoreGraphic(named: name, revision: nil)
170	        }
171	    }
172	
173	    // MARK: - Life cycle
174	
175	    init(
176	        document: ProjectDocument, act: GraphicFileAct, choices: [GraphicFileChoice],
177	        opening: String?
178	    ) {
179	        self.document = document
180	        self.act = act
181	        self.choices = choices
182	        self.opening = opening
183	        self.confirmButton = StickerButton(
184	            title: act.confirmTitle, style: .primary, target: nil, action: nil)
185	        super.init(nibName: nil, bundle: nil)
186	    }
187	
188	    @available(*, unavailable)
189	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
190	        fatalError("GraphicFileSheetController does not support NSCoder")
191	    }
192	
193	    override func loadView() {
194	        // Rows are `NSMenuItem`s carrying the name: `addItem(withTitle:)`
195	        // removes a row with the same title, and a row is never read by index.
196	        for choice in choices {
197	            let row = NSMenuItem(title: choice.title, action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
198	            row.representedObject = choice.name
199	            popup.menu?.addItem(row)
200	        }
201	        if let row = popup.itemArray.first(where: { $0.representedObject as? String == opening }) {
202	            popup.select(row)
203	        }
204	        popup.font = DS.sans(13)
205	        popup.target = self
206	        popup.action = #selector(popupChanged(_:))
207	        popup.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.controlWidth).isActive = true
208	        popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.popup")
209	
210	        nameField.delegate = self
211	        nameField.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.controlWidth).isActive = true
212	        DSField.style(nameField)
213	        nameField.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.name")
214	
215	        keptLabel.font = DS.mono(11)
216	        keptLabel.textColor = DS.textMuted
217	        keptLabel.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.kept")
218	
219	        messageLabel.font = DS.sans(12)
220	        messageLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
221	        messageLabel.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2
222	        messageLabel.isHidden = true
223	        messageLabel.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.message")
224	
225	        var rows: [[NSView]] = [[fieldLabel("Graphic:"), popup]]
226	        if act == .rename { rows.append([fieldLabel("New name:"), nameField]) }
227	        if act == .restore { rows.append([NSGridCell.emptyContentView, keptLabel]) }
228	        let grid = makeSheetGrid(rows)
229	
230	        let content = sheetColumn([grid, messageLabel])
231	
232	        confirmButton.target = self
233	        confirmButton.action = #selector(confirmClicked(_:))
234	        confirmButton.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.confirm")
235	        let cancelButton = sheetCancelButton(target: self, action: #selector(cancelClicked(_:)))
236	        view = makeSheetView(
237	            title: act.sheetTitle, hint: act.hint, content: content,
238	            buttonRow: makeButtonRow(
239	                cancel: cancelButton, apply: confirmButton,
240	                leading: act == .rename ? [sheetFootnote("lowercase letters, digits and -")] : []))
241	        syncChoice()
242	    }
243	
244	    // MARK: - Values
245	
246	    private var chosenName: String? { popup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String }
247	
248	    /// The chosen row into the controls that follow it: Rename's field and
249	    /// Restore's kept line; then the button.
250	    private func syncChoice() {
251	        let name = chosenName
252	        nameField.stringValue = name ?? ""
253	        let kept = choices.first { $0.name == name }?.kept ?? 0
254	        keptLabel.stringValue = Self.keptLine(kept)
255	        syncConfirm()
256	    }
257	
258	    private func syncConfirm() {
259	        confirmButton.isEnabled = chosenName.map {
260	            Self.canConfirm(act, name: $0, to: nameField.stringValue)
261	        } ?? false
262	    }
263	
264	    // MARK: - Controls
265	
266	    @objc private func popupChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
267	        syncChoice()
268	    }
269	
270	    func controlTextDidChange(_ obj: Notification) {
271	        syncConfirm()
272	    }
273	
274	    // MARK: - Commit
275	
276	    @objc private func cancelClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
277	        dismiss(self)
278	    }
279	
280	    /// The act, once. A refusal beeps and shows the body's sentence, and
281	    /// the sheet stays up; a success closes it and says nothing.
282	    @objc private func confirmClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
283	        guard let document = document, let name = chosenName,
284	            Self.canConfirm(act, name: name, to: nameField.stringValue)
285	        else {
286	            NSSound.beep()
287	            return
288	        }
289	        do {
290	            try Self.perform(act, name: name, to: nameField.stringValue, on: document)
291	        } catch {
292	            NSSound.beep()
293	            let message = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
294	            messageLabel.stringValue = message
295	            messageLabel.isHidden = false
296	            return
297	        }
298	        dismiss(self)
299	    }

import AppKit

#if FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS
/// `perform_menu_item`'s allow-table (road map 11's V2b): one row per
/// selector in `tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.json`, in its order, with
/// the verdict V1's inventory read for it — `none` (spelled `.plain`, so no
/// `Optional.none` ambiguity), `sheet`, `window`, `modal` or `framework`.
///
/// **A mirror, held to its source by the proof.** `v2_menu.py`'s H2 compares
/// this table to the inventory in both directions and H1 holds the inventory
/// to the live menu, so a menu item added without a row here is refused as
/// `unclassified` by the tool and fails the proof until both are written.
/// `UIMenu.refusal(for:)` refuses `framework` and `modal` rows by name and
/// every selector with no row.
extension UIMenu {
    static let verdicts: [String: Verdict] = [
        "showAboutPanel:": .window,
        "showSettings:": .window,
        "hide:": .framework,
        "hideOtherApplications:": .framework,
        "unhideAllApplications:": .framework,
        "terminate:": .framework,
        "newProject:": .modal,
        "newRecording:": .window,
        "pauseOrResumeRecording:": .plain,
        "openDocument:": .framework,
        "clearRecentDocuments:": .framework,
        "performClose:": .framework,
        "saveDocument:": .framework,
        "saveDocumentAs:": .framework,
        "revertDocumentToSaved:": .framework,
        "addMediaFiles:": .sheet,
        "importCaptions:": .sheet,
        "generateCaptions:": .sheet,
        "exportCaptions:": .sheet,
        "consolidateMedia:": .sheet,

"""The capture spike's Q2(c) inventory: which menu items reach a sheet, a
modal run loop, or neither — and the checks that hold `inventory.json` to
the tree (road map 11, V1).

`inventory.json` is READ BY HAND, site first: every line the grep below
finds is traced to the menu selectors that reach it, synchronously
(`reached_from`: the action method reaches the site before it returns) or
later (`reached_after`: from a sheet or panel completion, an async hop or an
AppKit delegate callback, with the `via` line and the `gate` that must hold).
Every other live selector is read to `none`, `window` or `framework`.
The grep counts the APP-MODAL `presentError(` (road map 11's V2b) — the
`presentError(_:)` / `NSApp.presentError(_:)` that runs a modal loop — and
not the sheet form `presentError(_:modalFor:…)`, which is not modal.

  I1  every leaf of `buildMainMenu()` (the probe's `menu` mode) has its
      selector in `selectors`, and every row there names a live selector;
  I2  the grep's sites and `sites` are one-to-one, each line holding its token
      and lying in its entry's `func`; a site is FOUND BY ITS TOKEN AND ITS
      ENCLOSING FUNCTION, not its line (#166, #168): `resolve` pairs the
      inventory's sites with the grep's per (file, token, func) — `func` the
      nearest `func NAME` or `init(` declaration at or above the line — in
      line order, whenever the two counts agree, so a line added above a
      site moves its pin instead of failing it; where they disagree each pin
      stands as written. A site removed and another added in one file and
      token no longer balance unless both are in one function, so a swap
      across functions is reported (K4);
  I3  every citation is checked for content (#168). A citation is a SITE ref,
      `app/Sources/<F>.swift:<N>` naming a key of `sites` (read at its
      resolved line), or an ANCHORED ref, ``app/Sources/<F>.swift `<anchor>` ``,
      whose anchor is a piece of the line meant and occurs exactly once in
      `<F>`. Each `code` item is exactly one citation; `note`, `via`, `gate`
      and `other_caller` hold citations in prose; any other `<F>.swift:<N>`
      is a problem, as is a line citation that is not a site, an anchor
      missing or not unique, and a `reached_after` whose `via` cites nothing.
      A `modal` selector cites a line holding a loop token, a `sheet` one a
      sheet token; every `reached_from` / `reached_after` selector names a
      row; a selector in the `reached_from` of a `runModal` or loop-token
      site is `modal` (`reached_after` never forces a verdict);
  I4  the checker over a copy missing one selector and one site reports
      exactly those two (the first selector no site references, and the
      first site no citation names by its line).

`python3 tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.py --check` is a line of
`make test`: no app, no probe, no build, in a fresh `work/inventory_check/`.

  K1  I2 and I3 over the tree have no problem (I1 needs the probe, so it is
      `v2_menu.py`'s H1); its detail lists the pins found at another line;
  K2  CONTROL: a copy of `app/Sources` with three blank lines put at the top
      of every file that holds a site or is cited by an anchor has no I2 or
      I3 problem;
  K3  CONTROL: a fresh copy, the inventory's site keys first rewritten
      through `resolve`, then the line of the first rewritten site blanked:
      the checker reports exactly that site under I2;
  K4  CONTROL: a fresh copy, the keys rewritten, the first site's line
      blanked and `func b13Swap() { <that line> }` appended as the file's
      last line — a swap in one file and token: I2 reports exactly that site
      (its line does not hold its token) and the appended line (a grep site
      missing from the inventory);
  K5  CONTROL: the first anchored `code` citation (selectors sorted) with an
      invisible U+2063 appended to its anchor: `check` reports exactly that
      selector under I3 beyond the tree's own problems.

Every control that writes into its copy calls `_forget(root)` after its last
write and before its `check`, because `line_of` caches each file it reads.

BARE = re.compile(r"(?<![\w/+])[\w+]+\.swift:\d+")

    word = match.group(1)

    return "runLoop"

content.content:
- **G-16 — Insert ▸ Graphic: where the clip goes, what the module is
  called, and what a module that does not compile does** (road map 10
  §10.9 G5b, 2026-09-25). Insert ▸ Graphic is `write_graphic` of a template
  or a chosen `.js`, then `add_graphic_clip` at the module's `meta`
  duration and size, as ONE undo step "Insert Graphic" (the file write is
  not undoable, G-3).
  (a) **Placement is Add Text's** (`addGeneratedClip`, §4.1 "at the
  playhead"): the front track if the clip fits there, else a new track
  above everything. So no track, or a playhead over a clip, never disables
  the item; it validates on the document's graphics store alone.
  (b) **The name is the file's stem made a module name, then made free**:
  lowercased, every run of anything but `a-z0-9` one `-`, trimmed, at most
  63 (`graphic` when nothing is left) — `My Counter (v2).js` is
  `my-counter-v2` — then `GraphicStore.uniqueModuleName`: the name when
  the folder holds no module of it, else `-2`, `-3`, …, so an insert never
  overwrites a module another clip draws. Duplicate as New Graphic…'s
  suggestion uses the same rule.
  (c) **A module that does not compile stays on disk and places nothing**:
  the person reads "graphics/<name>.js was written but does not compile:
  <the first diagnostic> (line N)" in a sheet, and can fix the file where
  it is.
- **G-17 — An export's Cancel only sets flags; a reader is cancelled only
  by the loop that reads it, and a read that never returns is not woken —
  accepted** (issues #73, #74, 2026-09-29). `ExportWriter.cancel()` and
  `Exporter.cancel()` set flags and nothing else. The measurement's loop
  (`Exporter.measureLoudness`) sees the flag between samples and cancels
  its own reader; the writer's reader and writer are cancelled in
  `allInputsFinished`, after every pump has left its loop. Why:
  `cancelReading()` from main while a pump was inside
  `copyNextSampleBuffer` crashed 12 of 30 mid-export cancels (road map 10
  §10.6 G3c, #38). A cross-thread watchdog that cancels a stuck reader is
  that same mechanism again, and abandoning the completion instead would
  leave a live reader and writer on the destination. The risk accepted: a
  read that never returns (a pump starved because the other stopped
  reading, or a volume that stops answering) keeps its export alive — the
  sheet or the queue's job never completes and the queue stalls behind it,
  action targets (§5.4's three groups), so they have no blend; a colour
  plate is a shape. At a `split` the join is exact (`clip_state` either
  side of the cut is equal); inside the head and the tail a sample
  matches the unsplit clip within the matrices' round-trip error (1e-6
  per channel), not exactly.

- **G-44 — The bundled templates: one unit, title-safe at every frame,
  a static card, the bundled faces, generic glyphs, an accent and an
  outro, held by a test** (owner, 2026-10-29: "I want to create some more
  default graphics"; seventeen added to road map 10's six).
  (a) **The unit.** A template sizes everything by
  `u = Math.min(ctx.width, ctx.height) / 1080`, which is the six's
  `ctx.height / 1080` in landscape and keeps a portrait (1080 × 1920)
  frame from drawing at 1.78 times the size.
  (b) **Title-safe at every frame.** Everything a template draws, at
  every frame, lies inside the 90 % title-safe rectangle
  (x ∈ [0.05W, 0.95W), y ∈ [0.05H, 0.95H)), at 1920 × 1080, at
  1080 × 1920 and at 1080 × 1080 (the square social canvas, which takes
  the landscape layout). An entrance is a spring, a clipPath wipe or a
  fade, never a move in from off-frame. Long user text is fitted or
  wrapped to stay inside, never kept out by narrowing the schema.
  (c) **A card's background is static.** A full-frame template (one that
  passes `background` to `svg`) draws the same background at frame 0 as at
  every later frame; its outro fades or moves the content only.

- **G-45 — Insert ▸ Graphic… is a dialog: categories, the graphics of
  one, and a looping preview; a template declares its category and a
  one-line description** (owner, 2026-10-29: a graphic browser in place of
  the Insert ▸ Graphic submenu; phase 1 of 2, `.fjgraphic` export being
  the second). Amends G-16.
  (a) **A module's category** is `meta.category` when it is a string that
  is not empty after trimming (trimmed), else "Other".
  (b) **Every bundled template declares one** of Data & Time,
  Screencast, Social & YouTube and Titles & Text, and a one-line
  `meta.description` of at most 120 characters, held by
  `graphic/tests/template_meta.rs` to (c)'s table.
  (c) **The table.** Data & Time: bar-chart, counter, countdown,
  donut-chart, gauge, line-chart, progress-bar. Screencast:
  arrow-highlight, callout, keyboard-keys, step-badge, window-frame.
  Titles & Text: chapter-card, kinetic-type, logo-reveal, lower-third,
  news-ticker, quote-card, title-card. Social & YouTube: end-screen,
  handle-tag, social-popup, subscribe-button.
  (d) **The list.** This Project first, and only when the package's
  `graphics/` holds a module: every project module, whatever its own
  category. Then the templates' categories by case-insensitive name, Other
  last. Within a category the graphics go by title case-insensitively,
  then by name. `list_graphics` answers the same order.
  (e) **The title** is `meta.name` when it is a non-empty string, else the
  stem's title (`lower-third` → "Lower Third"). A This Project graphic whose
  title equals another This Project graphic's, case-insensitively, is shown
  as "<title> — <module name>", in the dialog and in `list_graphics` alike,
  so two copies of one template can be told apart. The templates are now
  COMPILED to read their `meta`, once per process, against the bundled
  fonts; the menu bar still compiles nothing (chrome probes instantiate
  `AppDelegate()`).
  (f) **The door** is Insert ▸ Graphic…, a sheet (the submenu and its From
  File… item are gone; From File… is the sheet's bottom-left button, and
  its open panel follows once the sheet is down). Insert is G-16's act for
  a template: the module written under a free name (G-16 (b)), then one
  clip. For a This Project graphic it places a clip drawn by that module
  and writes no copy. Either is one undo step "Insert Graphic". A module
  that does not compile places nothing, and its sentence is "graphics/
  <name>.js does not compile: <the first diagnostic> (line N)" — in the
  dialog's message line, which stays up, or, for From File…, in a sheet
  (G-16 (c)'s "was written but" is gone, since a This Project graphic was
  not written). The agent's mirror is `list_graphics` and
  `insert_graphic {name, from}`.
EOF

after it ends E1 appears within 2 s, with none more.
  - **S1–S4** E1 is attached, the site is called, E1 is held (2 s for S2,
    1 s for the others), then E2 is presented and E1 is ended. Passes when
    the sheets show [E1], [the site's text], [E2] in that order, with none
    more within 2 s. S1 `frameSaved(.failure(NSError "probe frame"))`
    (`+SaveFrame` :209). S2 `addImageBackground(from: garbage.png)`
    (`+AddClips` :179); the text is what `MediaImporter.probeBlocking`
    throws for the file. S3 `placeImageBackground` of the 4×4 PNG's
    descriptor at `width = 70000` (`+AddClips` :236); the text is what
    `add_media` throws. S4 `consolidateAfterSave(didSave: true)` on
    the document given `fileURL = work/probe.framejob` and no media
    (`+Consolidate` :67); the text is what `MediaConsolidator.plan` throws.
  - A P1, P2 or X1 panel that does not attach within 3 s is an instrument
    failure (`instrument: panel did not attach within 3 s`), and so is an
    E1 that does not attach within 5 s in V1 or S1–S4. Such a failure is
    never the row's verdict. Exits follow rule R (1 / 0 / 2): a plain
    run's instrument failure is a scored FAIL, exit 1, and a `--mutant`
    run with any instrument failure exits 2.

**The fixture is per row** (the spec had one for the whole run). The first
`--mutant no-sheet-wait` run used one document and printed "S1–S4 fail —
instrument: E1 did not attach within 5 s" with P1, P2 and X1 FAIL, then
"the control could not be performed — instrument failure in S1, S2, S3,
S4", exit 2. P1 had left that document's queue jammed (E1 was dropped while
the handler's alert was up), so no later row's E1 could attach. With a
fresh document per row, each row measures the queue on its own.

### The 25 sites

Lines are at HEAD 8af4c7e (unchanged at f9d2506 and after this batch).
Class A: reached only synchronously from a validated editor action or from
a click or key in the editor window. The validator
(`EditorViewController.swift`'s `validateUserInterfaceItem`, measured by
V1) and the key guard refuse while any sheet is attached, and a
document-modal sheet takes the parent window's mouse and key events. Class
B: synchronous inside the completion handler of a panel on the editor
window. Class C: after an async hop. V1 tests that ONE guard
(`EditorViewController.swift:1042`, which refuses every action before its
switch while a sheet is attached); C0 controls it through `addMediaFiles:`
alone, since the other eleven may validate false on an empty document
regardless of any sheet.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Issue batch B7 (#146) — the one tree copy every proof that BUILDS the app
in a copy gets its copy from.

    python3 tools/proof/tree_copy.py --selftest

A proof that builds a mutant app must not build in the tree: xcodegen writes
`FrameJob.xcodeproj/`, `app/Info.plist` and `app/FrameJob.entitlements`, and
the helper's build step runs `bun install` and `bun build`, which write into
`agent/`. So the copy's `app/` and `agent/` are COPIED (`COPIED`), and every
other build input is a SYMLINK to the tree's — `core` already built, so
`project.yml`'s pre-build `cargo build --release` is a no-op and the copy
links the tree's `libframejob_core.a`.

**The build inputs are derived from `project.yml`, not listed by hand.**
`build_inputs` answers every top-level directory of the tree (no leading
`.`, not in `GENERATED`) whose name `project.yml` spells as `NAME/` not
preceded by a name character — `app/Sources`, `$PROJECT_DIR/core`,
`"$PROJECT_DIR/agent/build.sh"`. So a build step that reads a new top-level
directory is linked into every copy the day it lands, and no builder's copy
can miss it (#146: `graphics_proof.py`'s copy missed `agent/` and `docs/`).
`GENERATED` (`build`, `FrameJob.xcodeproj`) is never linked: a copy writes

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Spec §11 G-45, phase 1 of the graphic browser — `list_graphics`,
`insert_graphic`, and Insert ▸ Graphic…'s sheet as the dev tools see it —
against the built app.

    python3 tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py [--app PATH]
    python3 tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py --mutant list-templates-only

**The instances.** The built app (`proof_app`'s choice), launched in a
scratch home (`CFFIXED_USER_HOME=tools/proof/work/graphic-browser/home`,
`graphics_menu_proof.py`'s launch) on a scratch socket, stopped by PID:
once with `-RCDevAppearance light` for every row, then once with
`-RCDevAppearance dark` for U1's dark capture. Nothing persisting is
performed, no sheet is confirmed. At the start and at exit everything in
`work/graphic-browser/` but the last logs is removed.

**The fixture.** `new_project` at `work/graphic-browser/GB.framejob`, saved —
a package with no module.

S0  with the instance listening, `<home>/Library/Application Support` is a
    directory (the scratch home took). When it fails no tool is called.
L1  `list_graphics` on GB: no This Project; the categories are exactly Data
    & Time, Screencast, Social & YouTube, Titles & Text, each holding G-45
    (c)'s templates, ordered by title case-insensitively then name; every
    graphic is `from: template`, `ok: true`, its `category` its section's,
    its `title` the file's `meta.name`, its `description` a non-empty
    string;
I1  `insert_graphic {name: lower-third, from: template}` answers ok and
    `name: lower-third`; `graphics/lower-third.js` is byte-equal to
    `graphic/tests/graphics/lower-third.js`; one clip more, drawn by
    lower-third;
L2  `list_graphics` again: This Project first, holding exactly lower-third,
    titled "Lower third", `from: project`, category Titles & Text; then L1's
    four;
I2  `insert_graphic {name: lower-third, from: project}`: ok, `name:
    lower-third`, one clip more drawn by lower-third, and the package's
    `graphics/*.js` unchanged (no copy);
I3  `write_graphic broken` (a module that does not compile), then
    `insert_graphic {name: broken, from: project}`: refused with
    "graphics/broken.js does not compile: …", no clip added;
I4  `insert_graphic {name: nope}` from template is refused naming "nope" and
    listing lower-third among the templates; from project, naming "nope" and
    listing "broken, lower-third";
I5  `insert_graphic {name: lower-third, from: file}` is refused with "from
    must be template or project (got \\"file\\")"; and one with no `from` is
    refused naming `from`;
U1  (light, then dark on its own instance) `perform_menu_item {path:
    ["Insert", "Graphic…"]}` answers a non-null `sheet`; `snapshot_ui
    {window: sheet}` writes a non-empty PNG and a layout dump holding the
    nine identifiers `graphicbrowser.categories`, `.graphics`, `.preview`,
    `.title`, `.description`, `.message`, `.fromFile`, `.cancel`, `.insert`;
    `cancel_sheet` answers `how: cancel_button` and a null `sheet`, and
    GB's clips are as before;
Z1  every project closes and `grep "Frame Job: "` over each log prints
    nothing.

**The app-tier mutant** (`APP_MUTANTS`): a COPY of the tree
(`tree_copy.make_copy`) with one anchor replaced, built by the copy's own
`make app-debug` (`make app` under `RC_PROOF_APP=release`;
`tree_copy.build_app`), launched in the scratch home, light only. Rule R: exit
0 means its row FAILED in the copy — caught; 1 that it passed — survived; 2
that the control could not be performed (the copy did not build or launch,
or the row was not reached).
    list-templates-only   list_graphics' handler drops This Project   → L2
"""

import argparse
import atexit
import json
import re
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools/proof"))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import graphics_proof as gp  # noqa: E402  (attempt, complaints)
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import tree_copy  # noqa: E402

WORK = ROOT / "tools/proof/work/graphic-browser"
HOME = WORK / "home"
TEMPLATES = ROOT / "graphic/tests/graphics"
APP = proof_app.binary()
CALL_BOUND = 120
KEPT = ("framejob-light.log", "framejob-dark.log")

# G-45 (c).
TABLE = {
    "Data & Time": ["bar-chart", "counter", "countdown", "donut-chart", "gauge", "line-chart",
                    "progress-bar"],
    "Screencast": ["arrow-highlight", "callout", "keyboard-keys", "step-badge", "window-frame"],
    "Social & YouTube": ["end-screen", "handle-tag", "social-popup", "subscribe-button"],
    "Titles & Text": ["chapter-card", "kinetic-type", "logo-reveal", "lower-third", "news-ticker",
                      "quote-card", "title-card"],
}
IDENTIFIERS = ["graphicbrowser." + n for n in (
    "categories", "graphics", "preview", "title", "description", "message", "fromFile", "cancel",
    "insert")]
BROKEN = "export function render() { return"

# name -> (file under app/Sources, anchor, replacement, the row that must fail)
APP_MUTANTS = {
    "list-templates-only": (
        "AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift",
        "        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document).map { category in\n",
        "        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document)\n"
        "            .filter { $0.name != GraphicCatalog.thisProject }.map { category in\n",
        "L2"),
}

RESULTS = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    RESULTS.append((name, bool(ok)))
    print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name}", flush=True)
    if detail and not ok:
        print("       " + detail, flush=True)
    elif detail:
        print("       " + detail.splitlines()[0][:300], flush=True)


def remove_leftovers():
    if not WORK.is_dir():
        return
    for entry in WORK.iterdir():
        if entry.name in KEPT:
            continue
        if entry.is_dir() and not entry.is_symlink():
            tree_copy.remove_tree(str(entry))
        else:
            entry.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def reply(got):
    return got["reply"] if got["ok"] and isinstance(got["reply"], dict) else {}


def meta_name(stem):
    """The template file's `meta.name`, read from its text."""
    text = (TEMPLATES / f"{stem}.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    found = re.search(r'export const meta = \{\s*name: "([^"]*)"', text)
    return found.group(1) if found else None


def template_categories():
    """L1's want: [(category, [(name, title)])] in G-45 (d)'s order."""
    out = []
    for category in sorted(TABLE, key=str.casefold):
        items = [(stem, meta_name(stem)) for stem in TABLE[category]]
        items.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1].casefold(), item[0]))
        out.append((category, items))
    return out


def listed(client, project):
    """`list_graphics`' categories, or None and the error."""
    got = gp.attempt(client, "list_graphics", {"project": str(project)})
    if not got["ok"]:
        return None, got["error"]
    return reply(got).get("categories"), None


def outline(categories):
    return [(c.get("name"), [(g.get("name"), g.get("title")) for g in c.get("graphics") or []])
            for c in categories or []]


def clips_of(client, project):
    whole = reply(gp.attempt(client, "get_project", {"project": str(project)})).get("project") or {}
    clips = list(whole.get("clips") or [])
    return [c["graphic"]["name"] for c in clips if c.get("graphic")]


def modules_on_disk(project):
    folder = Path(project) / "graphics"
    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.glob("*.js")) if folder.is_dir() else []


def launch(app, look):
    HOME.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log = WORK / f"framejob-{look}.log"
    if log.exists():
        log.unlink()
    launched = mcp.launch(str(app), arguments=["-RCDevAppearance", look],
                          env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(HOME)}),
                          log_path=str(log), timeout=CALL_BOUND)
    if launched.client is not None:
        print(f"  instance ({look}) PID {launched.child.pid} at {launched.socket_path}",
              flush=True)
    return launched, log


def fixture(client, name):
    package = WORK / f"{name}.framejob"
    shutil.rmtree(package, ignore_errors=True)
    made = gp.attempt(client, "new_project", {"path": str(package)})
    saved = gp.attempt(client, "save_project", {"project": str(package)})
    if not made["ok"] or not saved["ok"]:
        return None, f"new_project {made}; save_project {saved}"
    return package, None


def tool_rows(client, project):
    """L1, I1, L2, I2, I3, I4, I5 on `project`."""
    print("\n1 — list_graphics and insert_graphic", flush=True)
    want = template_categories()

    # L1
    categories, error = listed(client, project)
    graphics = [g for c in categories or [] for g in c.get("graphics") or []]
    sections = [(c.get("name"), g) for c in categories or [] for g in c.get("graphics") or []]
    well_formed = all(
        g.get("from") == "template" and g.get("ok") is True and g.get("category") == section
        and isinstance(g.get("description"), str) and g["description"].strip()
        for section, g in sections)
    check("L1 list_graphics with no project module: no This Project; Data & Time, Screencast, "
          "Social & YouTube, Titles & Text, each G-45 (c)'s templates by title then name; every "
          "graphic from template, ok, its section's category, titled by its meta.name, with a "
          "description",
          error is None and outline(categories) == want and len(graphics) == 23 and well_formed,
          f"error {error}; got {outline(categories)}; want {want}; well formed {well_formed}")

    # I1
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third", "from": "template"})
    after = clips_of(client, project)
    written = Path(project) / "graphics/lower-third.js"
    same = written.exists() and written.read_bytes() == (TEMPLATES / "lower-third.js").read_bytes()
    check("I1 insert_graphic {lower-third, template}: ok, name lower-third, graphics/lower-third.js "
          "byte-equal to the template, one clip more drawn by lower-third",
          got["ok"] and reply(got).get("ok") is True and reply(got).get("name") == "lower-third"
          and same and sorted(after) == sorted(before + ["lower-third"]),
          f"{got.get('error') or {k: reply(got).get(k) for k in ('ok', 'name')}}; bytes equal "
          f"{same}; clips {before} → {after}")

    # L2
    categories, error = listed(client, project)
    first = (categories or [{}])[0]
    ours = first.get("graphics") or []
    check("L2 list_graphics after: This Project first, holding exactly lower-third (\"Lower "
          "third\", from project, category Titles & Text); then L1's four",
          error is None and first.get("name") == "This Project"
          and [(g.get("name"), g.get("title"), g.get("from"), g.get("category"), g.get("ok"))
               for g in ours] == [("lower-third", "Lower third", "project", "Titles & Text", True)]
          and outline((categories or [])[1:]) == want,
          f"error {error}; got {outline(categories)}")

    # I2
    on_disk = modules_on_disk(project)
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third", "from": "project"})
    after = clips_of(client, project)
    check("I2 insert_graphic {lower-third, project}: ok, name lower-third, one clip more drawn by "
          "lower-third, graphics/*.js unchanged (no copy)",
          got["ok"] and reply(got).get("name") == "lower-third"
          and sorted(after) == sorted(before + ["lower-third"])
          and modules_on_disk(project) == on_disk == ["lower-third.js"],
          f"{got.get('error') or reply(got).get('name')}; clips {before} → {after}; graphics "
          f"{on_disk} → {modules_on_disk(project)}")

    # I3
    wrote = gp.attempt(client, "write_graphic",
                       {"project": str(project), "name": "broken", "source": BROKEN})
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "broken", "from": "project"})
    check("I3 a project module that does not compile is refused with \"graphics/broken.js does "
          "not compile: …\" and places nothing",
          wrote["ok"] and not got["ok"]
          and got["error"].startswith("graphics/broken.js does not compile: ")
          and clips_of(client, project) == before,
          f"write {wrote.get('error', 'ok')}; insert {got.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}")

    # I4
    template = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                          {"project": str(project), "name": "nope", "from": "template"})
    project_ = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                          {"project": str(project), "name": "nope", "from": "project"})
    check("I4 an unknown name is refused naming it: from template listing lower-third among the "
          "templates, from project listing \"broken, lower-third\"",
          not template["ok"] and '"nope"' in template["error"]
          and "lower-third" in template["error"]
          and not project_["ok"] and '"nope"' in project_["error"]
          and project_["error"].endswith("broken, lower-third"),
          f"template {template.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}; project "
          f"{project_.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}")

    # I5
    bad = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third", "from": "file"})
    absent = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic", {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third"})
    check("I5 from \"file\" is refused as \"from must be template or project (got \\\"file\\\")\"; "
          "no from is refused naming from",
          not bad["ok"] and bad["error"] == 'from must be template or project (got "file").'
          and not absent["ok"] and "from" in absent["error"],
          f"file {bad.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}; none {absent.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}")


def sheet_row(client, project, look):
    """U1 in `look`: the sheet up, captured, its dump read, cancelled."""
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    ran = gp.attempt(client, "perform_menu_item",
                     {"project": str(project), "path": ["Insert", "Graphic…"]})
    up = reply(ran).get("sheet") is not None
    picture = WORK / f"U1-{look}.png"
    shot = gp.attempt(client, "snapshot_ui",
                      {"project": str(project), "window": "sheet", "path": str(picture)})
    ids = []
    try:
        with open(reply(shot).get("layout_path") or "") as handle:
            ids = [v.get("id") for v in json.load(handle)["views"] if v.get("id")]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        pass
    missing = [i for i in IDENTIFIERS if i not in ids]
    cancelled = gp.attempt(client, "cancel_sheet", {"project": str(project)})
    down = (reply(cancelled).get("how") == "cancel_button"
            and "sheet" in reply(cancelled) and reply(cancelled)["sheet"] is None)
    png = picture.exists() and picture.stat().st_size > 0
    check(f"U1 ({look}) perform_menu_item Insert ▸ Graphic… puts the browser up; snapshot_ui "
          "writes its PNG and a layout dump holding the nine graphicbrowser identifiers; "
          "cancel_sheet presses Cancel and leaves no sheet; the clips are as before",
          ran["ok"] and up and shot["ok"] and png and not missing and down
          and clips_of(client, project) == before,
          f"performed {ran.get('error', 'ok')}, sheet {up}, snapshot {shot.get('error', 'ok')}, "
          f"png {png}, missing {missing}, problems {reply(shot).get('problems')}, cancel "
          f"{cancelled.get('error') or reply(cancelled).get('how')}")


def session(app, look, rows):
    """One instance in `look`: S0, the fixture, `rows(client, project)`, the
    close, then Z1 over its log. False when the instance, the home or the
    fixture failed."""
    launched, log = launch(app, look)
    made = False
    closed = None
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            check(f"the {look} instance listens on its scratch socket", False,
                  f"no listening line for {launched.socket_path} in {log}")
            return False
        support = HOME / "Library/Application Support"
        check(f"S0 ({look}) the scratch home took: <home>/Library/Application Support is a "
              "directory", support.is_dir(), str(support))
        if not support.is_dir():
            return False
        project, why = fixture(launched.client, f"GB-{look}")
        made = project is not None
        check(f"the {look} fixture is made over MCP (new_project, save_project)", made, why or "")
        if made:
            try:
                rows(launched.client, project)
            except Exception as error:  # a row that could not run is a failure
                check("every row runs", False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            closed = gp.attempt(launched.client, "close_project",
                                {"project": str(project), "discard": True})
    finally:
        launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)
    lines = gp.complaints(log)
    check(f"Z1 ({look}) the project closes and grep \"Frame Job: \" over the log prints nothing",
          made and closed is not None and closed["ok"] and not lines,
          f"close {closed.get('error', 'ok') if closed else 'not reached'}; "
          + "; ".join(lines[:4]))
    return made


def mutate(sources, name):
    file, anchor, replacement, _ = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    text = (sources / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(anchor)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"anchor in {file}: expected once, found {count}")
    (sources / file).write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")


def app_mutant(name):
    """Rule R: 0 the row FAILED in the copy, 1 it passed, 2 the control was
    not performed."""

import json

    "Screencast": ["arrow-highlight", "callout", "keyboard-keys", "step-badge", "window-frame"],
    "Social & YouTube": ["end-screen", "handle-tag", "social-popup", "subscribe-button"],
    "Titles & Text": ["chapter-card", "kinetic-type", "logo-reveal", "lower-third", "news-ticker",

}
IDENTIFIERS = ["graphicbrowser." + n for n in (
    "categories", "graphics", "preview", "title", "description", "message", "fromFile", "cancel",
    "insert")]
BROKEN = "export function render() { return"

        "AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift",
        "        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document).map { category in\n",

        "            .filter { $0.name != GraphicCatalog.thisProject }.map { category in\n",

RESULTS = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    RESULTS.append((name, bool(ok)))
    print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name}", flush=True)
    if detail and not ok:
        print("       " + detail, flush=True)
    elif detail:
        print("       " + detail.splitlines()[0][:300], flush=True)


def remove_leftovers():
    if not WORK.is_dir():
        return
    for entry in WORK.iterdir():
        if entry.name in KEPT:
            continue
        if entry.is_dir() and not entry.is_symlink():
            tree_copy.remove_tree(str(entry))
        else:
            entry.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def reply(got):
    return got["reply"] if got["ok"] and isinstance(got["reply"], dict) else {}


def meta_name(stem):
    """The template file's `meta.name`, read from its text."""
    text = (TEMPLATES / f"{stem}.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    found = re.search(r'export const meta = \{\s*name: "([^"]*)"', text)
    return found.group(1) if found else None


def template_categories():
    """L1's want: [(category, [(name, title)])] in G-45 (d)'s order."""
    out = []

        items.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1].casefold(), item[0]))

def listed(client, project):

    got = gp.attempt(client, "list_graphics", {"project": str(project)})

    return [(c.get("name"), [(g.get("name"), g.get("title")) for g in c.get("graphics") or []])

def clips_of(client, project):
    whole = reply(gp.attempt(client, "get_project", {"project": str(project)})).get("project") or {}
    clips = list(whole.get("clips") or [])

    folder = Path(project) / "graphics"

    HOME.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log = WORK / f"framejob-{look}.log"
    if log.exists():
        log.unlink()

                          env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(HOME)}),
                          log_path=str(log), timeout=CALL_BOUND)
    if launched.client is not None:
        print(f"  instance ({look}) PID {launched.child.pid} at {launched.socket_path}",
              flush=True)
    return launched, log


def fixture(client, name):
    package = WORK / f"{name}.framejob"
    shutil.rmtree(package, ignore_errors=True)
    made = gp.attempt(client, "new_project", {"path": str(package)})
    saved = gp.attempt(client, "save_project", {"project": str(package)})
    if not made["ok"] or not saved["ok"]:
        return None, f"new_project {made}; save_project {saved}"
    return package, None

    """L1, I1, L2, I2, I3, I4, I5 on `project`."""
    print("\n1 — list_graphics and insert_graphic", flush=True)
    want = template_categories()

    # L1
    categories, error = listed(client, project)
    graphics = [g for c in categories or [] for g in c.get("graphics") or []]
    sections = [(c.get("name"), g) for c in categories or [] for g in c.get("graphics") or []]

        g.get("from") == "template" and g.get("ok") is True and g.get("category") == section
        and isinstance(g.get("description"), str) and g["description"].strip()
        for section, g in sections)
    check("L1 list_graphics with no project module: no This Project; Data & Time, Screencast, "
          "Social & YouTube, Titles & Text, each G-45 (c)'s templates by title then name; every "
          "graphic from template, ok, its section's category, titled by its meta.name, with a "
          "description",
          error is None and outline(categories) == want and len(graphics) == 23 and well_formed,
          f"error {error}; got {outline(categories)}; want {want}; well formed {well_formed}")

    # I1
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third", "from": "template"})
    after = clips_of(client, project)
    written = Path(project) / "graphics/lower-third.js"
    same = written.exists() and written.read_bytes() == (TEMPLATES / "lower-third.js").read_bytes()
    check("I1 insert_graphic {lower-third, template}: ok, name lower-third, graphics/lower-third.js "
          "byte-equal to the template, one clip more drawn by lower-third",
          got["ok"] and reply(got).get("ok") is True and reply(got).get("name") == "lower-third"
          and same and sorted(after) == sorted(before + ["lower-third"]),
          f"{got.get('error') or {k: reply(got).get(k) for k in ('ok', 'name')}}; bytes equal "
          f"{same}; clips {before} → {after}")

    # L2
    categories, error = listed(client, project)
    first = (categories or [{}])[0]
    ours = first.get("graphics") or []
    check("L2 list_graphics after: This Project first, holding exactly lower-third (\"Lower "
          "third\", from project, category Titles & Text); then L1's four",
          error is None and first.get("name") == "This Project"
          and [(g.get("name"), g.get("title"), g.get("from"), g.get("category"), g.get("ok"))
               for g in ours] == [("lower-third", "Lower third", "project", "Titles & Text", True)]
          and outline((categories or [])[1:]) == want,
          f"error {error}; got {outline(categories)}")

    # I2

    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third", "from": "project"})
    after = clips_of(client, project)
    check("I2 insert_graphic {lower-third, project}: ok, name lower-third, one clip more drawn by "
          "lower-third, graphics/*.js unchanged (no copy)",
          got["ok"] and reply(got).get("name") == "lower-third"
          and sorted(after) == sorted(before + ["lower-third"])
          and modules_on_disk(project) == on_disk == ["lower-third.js"],
          f"{got.get('error') or reply(got).get('name')}; clips {before} → {after}; graphics "
          f"{on_disk} → {modules_on_disk(project)}")

    # I3
    wrote = gp.attempt(client, "write_graphic",
                       {"project": str(project), "name": "broken", "source": BROKEN})
    before = clips_of(client, project)
    got = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic",
                     {"project": str(project), "name": "broken", "from": "project"})
    check("I3 a project module that does not compile is refused with \"graphics/broken.js does "

          and clips_of(client, project) == before,

                          {"project": str(project), "name": "nope", "from": "template"})

          not template["ok"] and '"nope"' in template["error"]
          and "lower-third" in template["error"]
          and not project_["ok"] and '"nope"' in project_["error"]
          and project_["error"].endswith("broken, lower-third"),
          f"template {template.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}; project "
          f"{project_.get('error', 'NOT refused')!r}")

    absent = gp.attempt(client, "insert_graphic", {"project": str(project), "name": "lower-third"})
    check("I5 from \"file\" is refused as \"from must be template or project (got \\\"file\\\")\"; "

    """U1 in `look`: the sheet up, captured, its dump read, cancelled."""
    before = clips_of(client, project)

    up = reply(ran).get("sheet") is not None

    down = (reply(cancelled).get("how") == "cancel_button"

          "cancel_sheet presses Cancel and leaves no sheet; the clips are as before",

          f"png {png}, missing {missing}, problems {reply(shot).get('problems')}, cancel "
          f"{cancelled.get('error') or reply(cancelled).get('how')}")

    fixture failed."""
    launched, log = launch(app, look)
    made = False
    closed = None
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            check(f"the {look} instance listens on its scratch socket", False,
                  f"no listening line for {launched.socket_path} in {log}")
            return False
        support = HOME / "Library/Application Support"
        check(f"S0 ({look}) the scratch home took: <home>/Library/Application Support is a "
              "directory", support.is_dir(), str(support))
        if not support.is_dir():
            return False
        project, why = fixture(launched.client, f"GB-{look}")
        made = project is not None
        check(f"the {look} fixture is made over MCP (new_project, save_project)", made, why or "")
        if made:

            except Exception as error:  # a row that could not run is a failure
                check("every row runs", False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            closed = gp.attempt(launched.client, "close_project",
                                {"project": str(project), "discard": True})
    finally:
        launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)
    lines = gp.complaints(log)
    check(f"Z1 ({look}) the project closes and grep \"Frame Job: \" over the log prints nothing",
          made and closed is not None and closed["ok"] and not lines,
          f"close {closed.get('error', 'ok') if closed else 'not reached'}; "
          + "; ".join(lines[:4]))
    return made


def mutate(sources, name):
    file, anchor, replacement, _ = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    text = (sources / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(anchor)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"anchor in {file}: expected once, found {count}")
    (sources / file).write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")

    """Rule R: 0 the row FAILED in the copy, 1 it passed, 2 the control was
    not performed."""
    row = APP_MUTANTS[name][3]
    print(f"graphic browser — the {name} MUTANT ({row} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(WORK / "mutant"))
    if made is None:

        return 2
    copy = Path(made)
    try:
        mutate(copy / "app/Sources", name)
    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(copy, 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    session(proof_app.executable(app), "light", tool_rows)
    scored = {n.split()[0]: ok for n, ok in RESULTS}
    if row not in scored:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {row} was not reached")
        return 2
    failed = [n.split()[0] for n, ok in RESULTS if not ok]
    caught = scored[row] is False
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — {row} "
          f"{'FAILED' if caught else 'passed'} in the copy (failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--app", default=str(APP))
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    app = Path(args.app)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    remove_leftovers()
    atexit.register(remove_leftovers)
    if args.mutant:
        return app_mutant(args.mutant)
    print("Spec §11 G-45 — the graphic browser: list_graphics, insert_graphic and the sheet",
          flush=True)
    if not app.exists():
        check("the app is built", False, str(app))
        print(f"\n0/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
        return 1

    def light(client, project):
        tool_rows(client, project)
        print("\n2 — the sheet over the dev tools", flush=True)
        sheet_row(client, project, "light")

    session(app, "light", light)
    session(app, "dark", lambda client, project: sheet_row(client, project, "dark"))
    good = sum(1 for _, ok in RESULTS if ok)
    print(f"\n{good}/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
    return 0 if RESULTS and good == len(RESULTS) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

          made and closed is not None and closed["ok"] and not lines,
          f"close {closed.get('error', 'ok') if closed else 'not reached'}; "
          + "; ".join(lines[:4]))
    return made


def mutate(sources, name):
    file, anchor, replacement, _ = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    text = (sources / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(anchor)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"anchor in {file}: expected once, found {count}")
    (sources / file).write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")


def app_mutant(name):
    """Rule R: 0 the row FAILED in the copy, 1 it passed, 2 the control was
    not performed."""
    row = APP_MUTANTS[name][3]
    print(f"graphic browser — the {name} MUTANT ({row} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(WORK / "mutant"))
    if made is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    copy = Path(made)
    try:
        mutate(copy / "app/Sources", name)
    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(copy, 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    session(proof_app.executable(app), "light", tool_rows)
    scored = {n.split()[0]: ok for n, ok in RESULTS}
    if row not in scored:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {row} was not reached")
        return 2
    failed = [n.split()[0] for n, ok in RESULTS if not ok]
    caught = scored[row] is False
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — {row} "
          f"{'FAILED' if caught else 'passed'} in the copy (failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--app", default=str(APP))
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    app = Path(args.app)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    remove_leftovers()
    atexit.register(remove_leftovers)
    if args.mutant:
        return app_mutant(args.mutant)
    print("Spec §11 G-45 — the graphic browser: list_graphics, insert_graphic and the sheet",
          flush=True)
    if not app.exists():
        check("the app is built", False, str(app))
        print(f"\n0/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
        return 1

    def light(client, project):
        tool_rows(client, project)
        print("\n2 — the sheet over the dev tools", flush=True)
        sheet_row(client, project, "light")

    session(app, "light", light)
    session(app, "dark", lambda client, project: sheet_row(client, project, "dark"))
    good = sum(1 for _, ok in RESULTS if ok)
    print(f"\n{good}/{len(RESULTS)} checks passed")
    return 0 if RESULTS and good == len(RESULTS) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
